en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing an ostrich farm. In the foreground are numerous ostrich chicks and several large eggs scattered on the ground. Behind them stands a wire-and-wooden fence, with many adult ostriches gathered closely along it. Trees can be seen in the background. The lower part of the card is blank for writing, except for a small printed copyright notice on the left and a red handwritten number on the right.
